name: Koleja
title: Levite after the return from exile
summary: Koleja is a person mentioned in the book of Nehemiah in connection with the rebuilding of Jerusalem after the Babylonian exile. He is known as an ancestor or family member among those who settled in Jerusalem after the return. The name appears in genealogical lists and administrative records from this period.

keyEvents.title: Koleja mentioned in Nehemiah's genealogy
keyEvents.description: Koleja is mentioned as the father of Maaseja, one of those who settled in Jerusalem after returning from Babylon.

keyEvents.title: Settlement in Jerusalem
keyEvents.description: After the return from exile, lots were cast to decide who would settle in the rebuilt Jerusalem. Koleja's descendants were among those who settled there.

keyEvents.title: Koleja as father of the false prophet Ahab
keyEvents.description: In the book of Jeremiah, a Koleja is mentioned as the father of Ahab, one of the false prophets who prophesied lies in Babylon and was punished.

keyEvents.title: God's judgment on false prophets in Babylon
keyEvents.description: The Lord announced through Jeremiah that Ahab, son of Kolaiah, and Zedekiah, son of Maaseiah, would be handed over to Nebuchadnezzar because of their false prophecies.
